RumorFact.Text: The bramble seed might be reaching to the core.

ExploreFact.Text: I followed directions from a Nomai who scanned the planet and made it into the core.
Inside the core was a glowing, pink crystal. I might be able to use this to assemble a device and dampen the asteroid's effects.

RumorFact.Text: I found Nomai recording talking about some sort of treasure hunt

ExploreFact.Text: The first clue was: "Behind the pedestal upon which you belong".
I found a clue that says "Beyond our mountain, which I would happily move for you."
I found a clue that says "Behind Sonchus' plant, that breathes life into the world as you do into mine."
I found a clue that says "In the wall by the stairs - hidden, unlike my love for you."
I found a clue that says "Somewhere within our shuttle, which will warp us high into the stars that shine in your eyes."
I found a final clue that says "And now, take this scroll and traverse to the bottom of the twin flat peaks to retrieve your prize."
I found some kind of vault.

RumorFact.Text: I followed clues left from a treasure hunt that led me to a vault.

ExploreFact.Text: Inside the vault was a heart that seems similar to the projection goop the Nomai used in my star system. I might be able to bring this to the future to assemble a device and dampen the asteroid's effects.
I found writing from a Nomai who discovered tunnels deep underground
These tunnels are said to lead to the planet's core.
There was also directions for the tunnels to the core: North, NorthWest, South, SouthEast, andd West.

RumorFact.Text: The bramble could be following underground tunnels.

ExploreFact.Text: I found a Dark Bramble seed on Ourea's Peak, the Nomai here seemed unaware of its origins.
The Nomai discovered that the bramble seed was deeply rooted into the ground and reaching towards the planet's core.
I found writing in the future talking about an expedition into the bramble seed.
I found the Nomai shuttle inside the seed, I don't see any signs of living Nomai.
I found Ernesto, the Magic Talking Anglerfish, in the bramble seed. He doesn't want me to interrupt his staring.
Ernesto says flying out of his bramble seed will take me where I need to go, and flying into the seed below him will take me back to the start.
I interrupted his staring and now we're not friends anymore ::(.
I found various Nomai buildings scattered across Ourea's Peak. Two on the ground, one on the cliffside of a mountain, and one on the top of a mountain.
I found a Nomai scroll next to a small Bramble Seed, they wondered what could be inside.
I found writings from two Nomai theorizing about being stolen from by another species.
